challenge: Execution of a large-scale double-curved stadium structure requiring precise sandwich panel coordination, structural alignment accuracy, waterproofing continuity, and controlled installation across complex arched roof geometry.
sipanel_solution: SIPANEL engineered a coordinated sandwich panel roofing system specifically optimized for the stadium’s double-arched structure, including panel layout optimization, waterproofing integration, and structural coordination.
engineering_decision: Engineering teams prepared detailed structural alignment studies, sandwich panel layout drawings, drainage coordination details, and installation sequencing strategies to ensure geometric precision and long-term roof performance.
execution_detail: Installation teams followed engineered sequencing procedures, controlled fastening coordination, structural alignment checkpoints, and sealing verification workflows throughout execution to maintain roof accuracy and waterproofing continuity.
measured_result: Successful delivery of a durable and visually integrated stadium facility with reliable sandwich panel roof performance, accurate curved geometry execution, and controlled installation quality.
primary_message: Engineered sandwich panel roofing systems designed for complex large-span sports structures.

metrics.execution_focus: Curved roof precision and waterproofing control
